description:
Follow-up to auto-merge-review-gate-soundness-paths (PR #912, already DONE). The
adversarial holistic-review found the gate is only half-real in production. The
code side is correct and sound: pr-open (Makefile:1161) and the
auto-merge-on-open.yml workflow share one predicate
(_project/scripts/auto_merge_soundness_paths.py, invoked with --no-renames) and
correctly WITHHOLD auto-merge enablement for PRs touching comparator/plan-parser
soundness paths. But nothing ENFORCES a review: the develop ruleset
`develop-squash-only` has required_approving_review_count: 0 and
require_code_owner_review: false (verified via `gh api repos/.../rules/branches/develop`;
legacy branch protection returns 404 "Branch not protected"). So a soundness-path
PR can still be squash-merged with zero approvals — manually or by re-enabling
auto-merge. The DONE item's success_metric ("PRs touching the comparator or plan
parsers cannot squash-auto-merge without a review") is NOT met at the repo level.

Two parts: (1) a CI meta-check that makes the gap LOUD and self-healing so it
cannot silently regress once set; (2) the actual ruleset change, which requires
a repo admin and is tracked here as the gating human action.

anti_patterns.dont: duplicate the soundness path list; the meta-check must read it from auto_merge_soundness_paths.py.
mark this Completed while the ruleset still shows review_count 0 / code-owner review false
anti_patterns.why: that repeats the overstated DONE metric.

deferrals.reason: Requires a repo admin (gh api PUT on the ruleset); cannot be done by an agent PR. Tracked as the gating human action for w3.
deferrals.resolved_reason: [G4 sweep] superseded: CLAUDE.md states this exact require_code_owner_review ruleset target was retired 2026-07-18; maintainer-manual-merge path replaces it.
deferrals.summary: Apply the develop ruleset change: require_code_owner_review=true.

preserves.behavior: Non-soundness-path PRs keep squash auto-merge on CI-pass; this item only hardens the soundness exception.
The code-side withholding behavior (pr-open + auto-merge-on-open.yml shared predicate, --no-renames) is unchanged.

prior_art.concept: {'ref': '.github/workflows/pr.yml:270', 'note': "Existing 'Oracle coverage map drift check' / drift-check step pattern in the lint job — model the ruleset meta-check on these gh-api-backed drift steps."}

{'ref': 'CODEOWNERS', 'note': 'Owns the soundness globs (parsers/**, equivalence/**, **/validation.py); require_code_owner_review only triggers if an owner team/user is actually assigned to those paths — verify, do not assume.'}

{'ref': '_project/scripts/auto_merge_soundness_paths.py', 'note': 'The shared soundness-path predicate; the meta-check should reuse its SOUNDNESS_PREFIXES so the CI assertion and the auto-merge withholding agree on one source of truth.'}

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/unit/release/ -k ruleset_review_enforcement -q
verifications.description: Meta-check fails on an unenforced ruleset and passes on an enforced one
verifications.expected: asserts the check fails when review_count<1 or code-owner review false; passes otherwise

work_units.notes:
Capture `gh api repos/joeharris76/BenchBox/rulesets` and the develop ruleset
detail; record required_approving_review_count and require_code_owner_review.
Confirm CODEOWNERS assigns a real owner to parsers/**, equivalence/**,
**/validation.py. Summarize (values + glob->owner) in the PR body.
work_units.summary: Re-confirm live ruleset state and CODEOWNERS ownership of soundness globs

work_units.notes:
Add a step in an ALWAYS-required job (e.g. pr.yml lint / code-lint), never
content-guard: content-guard is gated by content-guard-needed and skipped for
code-only PRs (ci-required-result ignores it unless content paths changed), so
a check placed there would let a code-only PR pass while review enforcement is
absent - defeating this item's stated self-healing guarantee. The step queries
the live develop ruleset via gh api and FAILS if require_code_owner_review !=
true. required_approving_review_count is deliberately NOT part of this check:
it is branch-wide, not CODEOWNERS-scoped, so asserting it here would gate
every develop PR rather than just soundness-path ones (see
ruleset_review_enforcement.py's module docstring). Reuse
auto_merge_soundness_paths.py SOUNDNESS_PREFIXES for the path set it narrates.
If a ruleset-read token is unavailable in CI, fall back to a documented manual
release-runbook checklist item and record that decision.
work_units.summary: Add a CI meta-check that fails when the develop ruleset lacks review enforcement
